plans.note: Two-sided liability provisions: check IBM's cap amount and carve-outs in 9.1 against our cap in 9.2 for mutuality; 5.4 (Other Disclaimers) may exclude consequential/data-loss damages and should be read together with 9.1.

8.1 is the IBM indemnity (test IP infringement scope, defence/settlement, remedies); 8.2 is our indemnity, which must stay narrow; sec-1 appears to be the indemnity procedure sub-list (prompt notice, control) applying to claims against Customer.

14.16 Freedom of Action likely preserves each party's right to compete rather than restricting us; confirm no covenant limiting our business in 14.11 (No Resale) or the AUP. Expect no non-compete on Customer.
Check 14.16 and the charges/order structure for any sole-source or all-requirements language; an IBM hosting agreement of this type usually has none.
No pricing-parity heading in the outline; scan 4.1 Charges for any obligation on us to offer IBM best terms. MFN running in our favour would not be flagged.
14.8 Personnel is the likely home of any hiring restriction; test whether it binds Customer, its duration, and whether general advertising/unsolicited applicants are carved out.

3.4 governs convenience termination — check notice length, whether it is mutual (IBM walking mid-term is unacceptable) and any termination charges; 3.3 and 3.5 inform penalties and wind-down consequences.
3.2 Renewal: test auto-renewal length, non-renewal notice window and whether renewal pricing/uplift is disclosed; 3.1 sets the initial term and 4.1 any price-change mechanic.

14.3 Choice of Law is the operative clause (accepted: NY, DE, CA, England & Wales; courts not foreign arbitration); 14.4 jury waiver and 14.14 limitations period are related but scored under other considerations only if they affect venue.
14.10 Assignment: confirm we may assign to affiliates and to a successor by merger/asset sale without consent, and that IBM has no termination right on our change of control.

12.1 License and 14.17 Limitation of Licenses define IP allocation; 11.6 Content and Digital Certificates and 14.18 Data Protection should confirm Customer retains ownership of its content/data with no assignment or broad licence to IBM.
12.1 is the grant — test scope for affiliates/contractors, revocability at will, and territory; 14.17 likely narrows it and 14.11 No Resale limits downstream use.

11.3 Suspected Violations is the most likely inspection/monitoring right against us; check notice, frequency, on-site access and cost allocation, cross-referencing the AUP in 13.2 and security in 5.3.
Look for late-payment interest, termination charges or stipulated damages payable by us in 4.1/4.2 and 3.4; service credits running to us are welcome and not flagged.

5.1 is IBM's warranty — test substance, duration and remedy; 5.2 Exclusivity of Warranties and 5.4 Other Disclaimers may gut it; 11.1 Services Support and 12.2 Maintenance of Base Components supply the practical remedy. 11.2 is Customer-side warranties.
No insurance heading in the outline; 5.3 Security and 14.12 Risk of Loss are the nearest neighbours. Likely a missing-clause finding given IBM hosts our data.
Check 4.1 Charges and the Order Form/Service Option Attachment structure for minimum volumes or take-or-pay; 11.5 Capacity Planning may impose committed capacity charges.

3.5 Effect of Termination is where data return and transition assistance would sit; if it only addresses accrued fees and access cut-off, flag the absence of a data-return/migration obligation. 14.2 confirms what survives.
